scan.summary: This is a permit from the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission authorizing Evergreen Botanicals to produce recreational marijuana at 2210 Bailey Hill Road in Eugene. The permit names specific conditions the company must follow, including annual renewal, Cannabis Tracking System use, video surveillance, and reporting of ownership changes. As the agency's own permit, it contains no gaps to fix; what matters is meeting the conditions and renewing before the expiration date.
scan.freshness_note: This license was issued on March 3, 2026, and is current. The next renewal deadline is February 10, 2027 (20 days before expiration). Since today is September 27, 2026, there are approximately five months until the renewal deadline.

conditions.title: License valid only for named premises and non-transferable

conditions.title: Annual renewal required
conditions.evidence_expected: Submitted renewal application and renewal fee receipt, received by OLCC no later than February 10, 2027. Once a complete renewal is submitted, the company may continue operating until the Commission acts on it.

conditions.evidence_expected: <cite index="25-1,28-1">Documentation that all marijuana items are tracked in Metrc (the Cannabis Tracking System), and records showing every employee has a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission</cite>. Employee permit numbers must be recorded in the tracking system.

conditions.title: Report changes in ownership, premises, or financial interests
conditions.evidence_expected: Written notice to the Commission submitted before any change takes effect. Documentation of the change (e.g., new ownership documents, premises modification permits, updated financial interest disclosures).

scan.confidence_notes: I am highly confident in the content and structure of this license. The document is clear, complete, and signed by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission. The conditions are straightforward. I verified through web search that the Cannabis Tracking System is indeed called Metrc, that OAR 845-025-1450 specifies video surveillance with 90-day retention and off-site real-time backup for the surveillance room, and that annual renewal is required 20 days before expiration. The renewal deadline of February 10, 2027 is calculated with certainty from the stated expiration date of March 2, 2027. I found no inconsistencies between the license language and the applicable Oregon statutes and rules (ORS 475C and OAR chapter 845, division 25) as current through 2026. The only uncertainty is whether there are unpublished updates to the specific OAR sections cited, but the core requirements appear stable.

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
